summary:
**MARS NAVIGATOR – A SURVIVAL GUIDE TO MARS**

MARS NAVIGATOR is an interactive platform designed to support the study and exploration of Mars. Focusing on Arcadia Planitia, it brings together scientific data about Martian terrain, surface temperature, and potential subsurface water ice.

Through an interactive map and visual data layers, users can explore different regions, understand environmental conditions, and identify areas that may require further investigation. The project aims to make complex scientific information easier to access and understand, while supporting hypothetical Mars exploration planning.

MARS NAVIGATOR is important because future human exploration of Mars will require reliable scientific information to understand the environment and make better-informed decisions.
details:
MARS NAVIGATOR is an interactive platform designed to help users explore and understand Mars, focusing on Arcadia Planitia.

The platform combines scientific data about terrain, surface temperature, and potential subsurface water ice. Through an interactive map and data layers, users can examine environmental conditions and identify areas of scientific interest.

Its main benefit is making complex scientific information easier to access and understand, supporting education, research, and future Mars exploration planning.

The project uses web development technologies and scientific datasets from NASA and other research sources. Its creative approach is bringing different types of Martian data together in one platform.

Our team considered terrain, temperature, potential water ice, data reliability, and the limitations of remote sensing. The risk assessment is our own analysis, not an official NASA safety evaluation.
